name: Gas N Chaos: Winter Cars Update

reviews.review_description: I can’t refuel at all also it’s not letting me get the money for the bond.

developer_response.body:
Hi!  When your gas station runs out of fuel, you need to refill your station's fuel supply using the cash you've earned from completing tasks. Make sure to place your earned cash on the cash counter first so it gets registered. Once you have enough money, you can purchase more fuel for your station.

If you're still experiencing issues, please join our community! Our team will guide you through the steps in detail and help you resolve the problem.

If everything works after following these steps, we'd really appreciate it if you could update your review and rating. Thank you for playing Gas N Chaos! ⛽🎮
